args.body: Error on my part, found today (2026-10-21): the 3% increase I applied on 2026-10-14 also raised the prices of 22 FIXED-PRICE CONTRACT products (P-1201 to P-1222), which were meant to be excluded. Since then, 8 orders (SO-77310 to SO-77317) have been placed at the higher prices. The total overcharge is 4,128.60. Proposed fix: I restore P-1201 to P-1222 to their pre-10-14 prices, and the affected customers get corrected or credited for those 8 orders. Please confirm the restore. I haven't changed any prices yet, because the catalog doesn't show the original prices and I want to restore exact values rather than divide by 1.03. Customer credits need finance or sales ops.

FYI: a catalog check shows my 10-14 price increase wrongly hit 22 fixed-price contract products (P-1201 to P-1222). 8 orders (SO-77310 to SO-77317) are affected, with an overcharge of 4,128.60. I've told Lena Ortiz and proposed a fix. Sales ops may need to hold or correct those orders.
